newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki bourse not to join Nordic co-op - paper.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki bourse not to join Nordic co-op - paper.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange is not not interested in joining the cooperation between the Stockholm and Copenhagen bourses announced on Thursday, the daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Friday.
The bourse had earlier said cooperation would be difficult, and although European cooperation models are still open, it may find opportunities there, especially if Finland joins EMU.
"It would be awkward if we were to tie our hands to cooperating only with Stockholm and Copenhagen," Helsingin Sanomat quoted bourse managing director Juhani Erma as saying.
